finalText:
**Redis loss at 02:14:07 crashed the service by 02:31:52.**

`redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` went down (`ECONNREFUSED`). `api` fell back to direct store reads, triggering cache miss storms and 5000ms timeouts across `api`, `worker-1`, `worker-2`, `scheduler`.

Reconnect attempts (1 through 12, every ~2min) all failed, so the storm never let up. Request queue depth climbed from 52 to 568 (cap 500) over 17 minutes.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, exited (code 134), and at `02:31:52` `api` went unresponsive — supervisor killed the process group, service down.

Root cause: `redis` at `10.0.0.12` never came back. Next step is checking why that Redis host stayed down.
